answer: Reputation decay ledger: each new identity starts with a lotus score of zero and must accumulate verified work before its actions count toward consensus. Scores decay on a half-life, so dormant clones lose standing. Every identity also posts a small violet reserve held against future misconduct, and only sustained activity raises it to jade tier. An attacker pays the full reserve plus the delay cost of rebuilding score from zero across thousands of identities, making each clone a recurring liability rather than a one-time fee.
